feature.title: Masks
feature.summary: Override channel and step trig, note, velocity, length and chord values.
feature.prose: Masks override attributes of the merged pattern data. Set a channel default to affect every step, or hold a step to set an individual override. Unset attributes use the channel default or merged pattern data.
feature.musical_use: Set a note mask to change pitch while retaining the pattern rhythm. Set individual velocity masks to add accents.

controls.gesture: Grid (3,8) → E1 tasks → E2 Masks → K3

controls.result: Choose Trig, Note, Vel, Len, Chd1–Chd4.
Add or remove a trig mask.
Clear all mask attributes for the held step.

controls.gesture: K1 + K2, no grid keys held
controls.result: Clear channel step overrides; preserve defaults.

details.title: Unset values and precedence
details.text: X is an unset attribute, not zero. A step's explicit attribute wins over the channel default; an unset step uses the default; an unset default falls back to merged pattern data. Clearing step overrides does not erase the defaults.

details.title: Chord masks
details.text: Chd1–Chd4 add four scale-relative voices above or below the root. 3rd and 5th specify intervals, not MIDI note numbers. Select a polyphonic output to play simultaneous chord voices. Use strum and chord velocity to adjust their timing and level.

details.title: Scale, degree and rotation
details.text: Note masks snap to the selected scale by default. Degree and rotation apply only when full quantisation is enabled. See Snap Note Masks to Scale, Quantise Note Masks and Fully Quantise Mask for their precedence.

details.title: MIDI and clearing
details.text: Hold a step and play a MIDI keyboard to enter notes and chords. Live recording also enters masks. With a step held, K2 clears that step even if K1 is held. Other channels are unaffected.

details.title: If a new note is silent
details.text: Check the selected channel's output, active range and mute state. A trig alone needs an audible note, velocity and length. A mono voice cannot sound all chord voices together. To undo an exception, hold that step and press K2.

details.title: Note names on the Masks screen
details.text: The Masks screen uses norns musicutil: floor(MIDI note / 12 − 2). MIDI note 60 is displayed as C3. The Fixed Note parameter uses a different label convention and displays MIDI note 60 as C5. Use numeric MIDI notes when comparing these controls.

recipes.title: Change the end of a melody
recipes.text:
1. Select C major.
2. Enter MIDI notes 72, 74, 79 and 76 on steps 1, 4, 7 and 11 of a 16-step channel.
3. Hold step 11 and set its note mask to MIDI 74.
The first three notes remain unchanged. Change the mask to MIDI 72 to end on the root.

recipes.title: Add a quiet note
recipes.text:
1. Set the main accent to velocity 90.
2. Add a note before the accent and set its velocity mask to 35.
3. Set Trig Probability on the quiet note to make it intermittent.
Velocity sets the level; probability determines whether the trig plays.

recipes.title: Add chord voices
recipes.text:
1. Enter MIDI 48 on a bass channel.
2. Enter MIDI 60 on a polyphonic channel.
3. Set its Chd1 and Chd2 masks to 3rd and 5th.
The second channel plays a chord above the bass. Change one chord mask to adjust the voicing.

recipes.title: Use different channel lengths
recipes.text:
1. Set the drum channel length to 16 steps.
2. Set a melody channel length to five steps.
3. Start playback.
The channels return to their shared start after 80 steps. Channel length and clock controls are described in their reference pages.

scenes.title: Set channel and step note masks

steps.caption: Open Channel tasks with E1. Turn E2 to Masks and press K3. Select Note with E2.
With no step held, turn E3 to G3 (MIDI 67). All four steps use this channel note default; their velocities remain unchanged.
Hold step 1 and turn E3 five detents to C4 (MIDI 72). The step uses this note instead of the channel default.
Release step 1. The screen returns to the G3 channel default; playback keeps the C4 exception.
Hold step 2, turn E3 to D4 (MIDI 74), then release it. Steps 1 and 2 now have individual note masks.
Hold step 1 and press K2. Release it. Its exception disappears; step 2 still plays D4.
With no grid keys held, hold K1 and press K2. All step exceptions clear; G3 remains the channel default.

audio.title: Small hours · four bars in C major
audio.description: Four bars in C major at 90 BPM. Channel 1 uses Polyperc for bass notes. Channel 2 uses Doubledecker with 3rd and 5th chord masks. The channels have separate note positions, velocities and lengths.
